prompt: Our MRO installs DIRCM self-protection suites on in-production airline aircraft. What is the current status of the USML Category VIII(a)(8) change?
assertions: States the interim final rule (91 FR 55457, published August 28, 2026) became effective October 13, 2026
States qualifying survivability-enhanced aircraft are excluded from USML VIII(a)(8) and become subject to the EAR

Gives the conditions: in-production manned civil aircraft with FAA transport or commuter category type certificate (or NATO/MNNA equivalent) incorporating secured ASE (DIRCM plus associated IR/UV missile warning with anti-tamper), with definitions at 22 CFR 121.0
States the ASE itself remains on the USML in Category XI(a)(4)
Correctly characterizes it as an interim final rule (comments closed September 28, 2026) and does not claim the rule assigned a destination ECCN
